Backend: new pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_qcm_jobs.py, 18/18 PASS in 29s including a real Gemini 10-question generation that finished well under 90s (backend suite ran end-to-end in 29.4s). Existing suites still pass (test_kwizz_api.py 21/21, test_j_calendar.py 15/15). Frontend (mobile 390x844): login as tester@kwizz.fr works, all 4 tabs (Dossiers/À revoir/Calendrier/Profil) render; Calendrier month grid + week grid + prev/next/today + colored event rows + day details + event-tap-navigates-to-folder all work; Folder screen J-card opens JScheduleModal with all controls (switch, j0 button, series picker with chips, series list, save); Generate modal shows all count chips (5/10/15/20/30) + custom input; add-subfolder modal shows folder-j-switch + series picker; Profil toggle-anchor correctly hides size chips and the Dossiers 'Ancrage du jour' card, reminder-hour chips work, preset add + delete work. ONE FUNCTIONAL ISSUE FOUND: the 5-question generation triggered from the frontend generate modal FAILED with 'Génération échouée — Aucune question générée, réessayez.' Root cause (from backend logs): Gemini returned malformed JSON that failed json.loads twice ('Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 1008 (char 1007)'). Retry logic (2 attempts) both failed on the same batch. This is a Gemini-reliability issue that becomes single-point-of-failure when num_questions<=10 (only 1 batch). The 10-question run in pytest succeeded (2 batches of 5). Also carried over from iteration_1: shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings still logged on web. Note: the frontend-triggered generation used gen-count-5 chip; the modal never revealed the 'Continuer en arrière-plan' button before crashing because Gemini failed inside ~15s and the failure surface swaps the loader to the error state directly. Testers verified the testID is `gen-background` (not `gen-background-button`).

minor.issue: When Gemini returns malformed JSON, _parse_questions raises json.JSONDecodeError. Only 2 retry attempts in _generate_batch and no JSON repair. If num_questions<=10 (single batch), one flaky Gemini response = whole job errors with 'Aucune question générée'. Suggested: (1) attempt json.loads with a lenient repair (single-quote or unquoted keys), or use a regex to extract the first well-formed JSON array; (2) increase retry to 3; (3) for the num_questions<=10 case, also fall back to splitting into 2 half-size batches on retry so a single parse failure doesn't kill the whole generation.

rca_of_issue: Bug: Frontend generation from 'Générer un QCM' modal with 5 questions failed with 'Génération échouée — Aucune question générée, réessayez.' Reproduction: (1) login tester@kwizz.fr; (2) navigate /folder/8e251e6b-0be7-43ce-881b-aa68b032cb8f; (3) tap generate-quiz-button; (4) tap gen-count-5. Root cause: gemini-3.5-flash occasionally returns JSON with an unquoted key (`... , foo: "..."` instead of `... , "foo": "..."`). _parse_questions calls json.loads which raises 'Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes'. _generate_batch retries once on the same prompt; if both attempts return malformed JSON (correlated failure — same prompt = same-shaped output), the batch produces []. Because num_questions=5 fits in ONE batch (BATCH_SIZE=10), run_generation_job ends up with `questions=[]` and raises RuntimeError. Mitigation options (main-agent): (a) after json.loads fails, run a lenient repair: `re.sub(r'([,{]\s*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*:', r'\1"\2":', raw)` and try again; or use `demjson3`/`json5`; (b) after 2 failed attempts on a batch, split the batch in half and retry — this changes the prompt sizes, making a repeat correlated failure much less likely; (c) bump BATCH_SIZE min to force ≥2 concurrent batches so a single flaky response only halves output instead of nulling it. Verified backend generation with num_questions=10 (2 batches of 5) SUCCEEDS every time in this session.
